summary: Frontend test of the new multiselect filters on /clients (Ejecutivo Propietario and Implementador) as admin rgonzalez, and how they work with mass selection and mass actions. Used 4 isolated TEST_FLT clients created by a fixture and deleted afterwards. Everything requested works. Both buttons appear next to the segment filter and show 'Todos (Ejecutivo)' / 'Todos (Implementador)'. The lists show 'Sin asignar' plus the values found in the data, sorted A-Z, and the search box filters them. Several values can be checked at once. Values inside one filter combine with OR: Alfa alone shows 2 rows, Alfa+Beta shows 4. Filters combine with each other with AND: Alfa|Beta with Impl Uno shows rows 1 and 3, and adding 'Sin asignar' to the implementer filter gives rows 1, 3 and 4. Adding segment Pymes leaves only row 1. Ejecutivo 'Sin asignar' alone shows 625 rows, matching the API. Button labels read 'Ejecutivo: 2' or the single name. 'Quitar filtro' and client-clear-filters-btn ('Limpiar') both reset to all 1145 rows, and the Limpiar button hides afterwards. The master checkbox selected only the 4 filtered rows. Narrowing the filter cut the selection from 4 to 2 and the master checkbox stayed checked. A mass segment change to Mixto on those 2 rows processed 2. In the DB only cli_testflt_1 and cli_testflt_3 became Mixto; rows 2 and 4 kept Pymes and no other client was touched. Filters stay applied after the grid reloads, and the selection resets to 0.

ui_bugs.issue: Two different users are both named 'Anderson Godoy' (user_54999f93a974 with 15 clients and user_1bb4605153e7 with 3 clients). The list shows two identical 'Anderson Godoy' options that cannot be told apart. CommandItem uses value={o.label}, so cmdk treats them as the same item: both highlight together (data-selected=true on 2 items), and pressing Enter can toggle the wrong one. Fix: use value={`${o.label} ${o.value}`} as SearchableSelect already does. You could also add a hint such as the email to tell them apart, or merge the duplicate user.

issues: The Ejecutivo/Implementador buttons (Button size=sm) use smaller text than the segment Select trigger and search input next to them, so the row looks slightly uneven. Consider text-sm to match.

action_items: MultiSelectFilter.jsx: make each CommandItem value unique (label + value) so options with the same name do not highlight or select together
Optional: make the filter buttons the same font size as the segment select
critical_code_review_comments: ejKey/implKey fall back to the name when there is no user_id. If some records of one person have a user_id and others only the name, that person will show up as two options. The current data has no such case, but it is fragile.
Options are built only from the clients already loaded, so users with no assigned clients never appear. This is fine for filtering.
Clients.jsx is about 2400 lines, far above the 700-line guideline. The filter logic could move to a hook such as useClientFilters.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_FLT clients (cli_testflt_1..4) with the fixture and deleted them afterwards (cleanup ok). No real data was changed.
